When I say this was the best money I’ve ever spent, I’m not joking. Suffered with a bad back for over 2 years due to previously carrying excessive weight. Lost the weight, still felt 50kg heavier and suffered daily, but just got used to it. On my first visit I told dr David all of my pains, specifically my upper back between shoulder blades. He got rid of years of pain in 1 swift move.

The relief was that euphoric that it brought me to tears in real time. I have never experienced anything like it.

If you have pain or discomfort, don’t waste your time being in pain like I have, Dr David will help.

(I’m also writing this the following morning after one of the best sleeps I’ve had in as long as I can remember)

I'm 72 years old, and I thought that at my age, there were very few benefits to be gained from the science of chiropractic before being treated at Spine Clinic by Dr. David, chiropractor.
For over 40 years, after a false move in judo, I regularly experienced numbness in my left thigh muscle, which made my daily life uncomfortable for walking activities.
Recently, due to sciatica, I could no longer put one foot in front of the other to walk unaided.
I had to hold myself to walk 10 meters. I was completely bent over with pain that started in my lower back and went down my left thigh and leg.
I noticed immediate improvements after the first session, was amazed and surprised by the difference a single session could make.
I felt reassured and full of hope.
In just six treatment sessions with Dr. David, and with the help of his team of highly skilled masseuses, following the instructions to regularly perform the exercises and stretches at home recommended by Dr. David, I am amazed to have regained normal mobility in my left leg while improving my overall well-being in a safe and natural way.
Dr. David took the time to listen to my concerns, understand my pain and its history, clearly explained what he was going to do, and devoted all his energy to achieving the best possible results.
I am delighted with the Spine Clinic; the team is very professional and passionate, and they always make us feel welcome upon our arrival.
The progress I have seen encourages me to continue using their services.
Congratulations and a big thank you.
